subject: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: TerraCloud Sales <terra@terracloud.io>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@hypernova.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request

Hi Mike / TerraCloud team,

We’re excited to kick off the 2-week marketplace pilot starting Nov 29. To make the experience consistent for buyers we need a short-lived reservation/carveout in the Dedicated pool for the pilot window (Nov 29–Dec 13) and an autoscale policy exception for burst-to-reserved for the same period.

Key asks: 
- Temporary reservation: 8 GPU slots (p4d-equivalent) during pilot days (8a–8p PT) Mon–Fri.
- Autoscale exception: allow short bursts to 12 slots if sustained QPS spikes > 90th percentile for 5m.
- Monitoring hooks & automatic rollback if tail latency > 250ms for 5m.

I attached a short proposal (pilot-reservation-proposal.xlsx) with expected QPS and client-side traffic curves. Can you confirm availability and whether TerraCloud can accept these constraints?

If this needs procurement/contract tweaks (SLA carveout / usage cap), loop me in — we can accelerate approvals if ops and CloudOps give a green light.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-reservation-proposal.xlsx
From: Mike Tran <mike@apollotech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudOps Team <cloudops@hypernova.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request

Thanks Stephanie — this sounds workable on our side but I need two clarifications before we confirm:
1) Can you share the expected sustained QPS and peak token/sec for the 8-slot baseline and the 12-slot burst?
2) Is the 8a–8p window strict or negotiable (some of our sellers prefer early-evening demos outside that window).

We can accept a temporary carveout with a formal usage cap and an evidence-backed rollback clause. I’ll coordinate with TerraCloud procurement to pre-stage a short-term amendment if CloudOps signs off on the autoscale exception.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request

Hi all — technical ops notes and a suggested guardrail set.

We can support a temporary reservation + autoscale carveout but need to formalize the runtime constraints. From the attachment and prior pilots I recommend the following conservative config: 
- Reservation baseline: 8 slots pinned to the pilot tenant (isolated slice).
- Burst ceiling: 12 slots, auto-revoke if average tail latency > 220ms over a 3m window (this is tighter than your 250ms ask; reduces risk to other customers).
- Scheduling: enable reservation only 07:30–20:30 PT Mon–Fri (gives some buffer).
- Billing: mark usage to a pilot ledger and cap at 1,200 GPU-hours; overages require manual approval.

Operational requirements: 
1) CloudOps must add two Prometheus hooks (tail_latency_99, active_slots) with an alert to #dedicated-ops.
2) We’ll deploy an ops-exception-runbook.md that defines the automatic rollback path and the manual escalation (SRE on-call + Product Ops).

If that’s acceptable, Laura and I will schedule a dry-run for the rollback flow on Nov 25 (non-prod).

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 10:03 AM Mike Tran <mike@apollotech.com> wrote:
> Can you share the expected sustained QPS and peak token/sec for the 8-slot baseline and the 12-slot burst?

—Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: ops-exception-runbook.md
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@hypernova.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request

Thanks Dev — this is reasonable, with a few risk mitigations I want recorded before ops sign-off: 

- Reduce baseline reservation to 6 slots during the first 3 business days as a canary; allow immediate escalation to 8 slots if client metrics match projected curve (we’ll automate the check).
- Require a scheduled reservation window (Nov 29–Dec 03: 06:00–20:30 PT) with a manual unlock for evening demos after a 24h notice.
- Limit burst extension to 10 slots for the canary period; full 12-slot burst can be allowed after Nov 30 if SLOs hold.

Risks: noisy multitenant workloads and unobserved prefix caching could skew tail latency; automatic rollback must include cache flush limits and KV cache isolation if possible.

I’ll open a short JIRA (INF-2741) to track the implementation tasks for CloudOps and SRE. Laura — can you coordinate the procurement amendment language for the usage cap and rollback clause?

On Tue, Nov 16, 2026 at 09:22 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:

—Kimberly

Date: 2026-11-18T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pilot headroom + temporary autoscale exception request

Appreciate the quick coordination everyone — summary and next steps: 

Decisions: 
- Canary reservation: 6 slots for Nov 29–Dec 1 (06:00–20:30 PT).
- Post-canary: increase to 8 baseline and allow 10-slot burst until Nov 30; full 12-slot burst permitted after Dec 1 conditional on SLOs.
- Autoscale exception window: Nov 29–Dec 13 with the described monitoring hooks and automatic rollback.
- Usage cap: 1,200 GPU-hours on a pilot ledger; overages require procurement approval (Laura).

Action items: 
- Kimberly/CloudOps: create INF-2741 and add Prometheus hooks + alerting by Nov 24.
- Dev: deploy ops-exception-runbook.md and schedule a dry-run Nov 25 (non-prod).
- Laura: draft the short-term amendment and DocuSign link for Apollotech procurement; target signature by Nov 26.
- Mike/Apollotech: confirm demo schedules that need evening unlocks by Nov 22.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize timing — calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/steph-nov-pilot (please accept or propose another slot).

Thanks — I’ll mark the agreement in HubSpot (DEAL-9341) and attach the pilot spreadsheet and the SLA redline for procurement.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
